continuity: Baekhwi was killed without leaving a corpse during the Great Snow Mountain battle; Baeksang identifies the Great Snow Fiend as the killer.
Venerable Wusang, former Sect Leader of the Zhongnan Sect and master of the Wind-and-Cloud Sword Lord, died while fighting with a recurring Internal Injury, ultimately killed by the Great Snow Fiend.

Baeksang claims that the Zhongnan Sect and other Western Army allies deliberately ignored his request for support, killed the messenger, pursued retreating Demonic Cult forces for military credit, and later removed the messenger's corpse and other evidence.
Baeksang's hatred of the Central Plains and Han Chinese stems from his belief that Nanman allies were betrayed after fighting in the Great Faction War.
Baeksang attacked Jin in the underground prison with tangible internal energy, cutting Jin's forehead, but Jin remained still and confronted him.
plot: Baeksang recounts the battle at Great Snow Mountain during the Great Faction War. The Southern Army, led alongside the Zhongnan Sect under Venerable Wusang, was ambushed by an elite Demonic Cult strike force. Baekhwi disappeared while pursuing the enemy with several warriors, and Baeksang later learned that the Great Snow Fiend had killed him and Venerable Wusang. Baeksang further claims that allied forces deliberately withheld support, killed the messenger, pursued the retreating enemy for military credit, and later erased the messenger's corpse and the evidence implicating the Zhongnan Sect. His old hatred of the Central Plains and Han Chinese erupts against Jin in the underground prison, where he attacks and declares that Jin's people taught him what he had to do.
translation_decisions: Render 대설귀 as Great Snow Fiend.
Distinguish the Southern Army (남군) from the Western Army (서군) in the Great Faction War account.
Retain Outer Lands for 새외 and Han Chinese for 한족.

active_continuity: Jin Taekyung remains imprisoned in the Nanman Beast Palace's underground prison, bound by iron balls and unable to use internal energy because of the Force-Sealing Pill; his execution is scheduled for noon in two days.
Baeksang has secured the support of twenty tribal chieftains and is using Jin's execution as the final-day agenda of the Tribal Grand Council.
Baekhwi was Baeksang's only child and was killed without leaving a corpse during the Great Snow Mountain battle; Baeksang identifies the Great Snow Fiend as the killer.
Venerable Wusang was the former Sect Leader of the Zhongnan Sect, master of the Wind-and-Cloud Sword Lord, and a Supreme Peak master who died during the Great Snow Mountain battle.

Baeksang claims that the Zhongnan Sect and other Western Army allies deliberately withheld support, killed the messenger, pursued retreating enemies for military credit, and erased the surviving evidence.
Baeksang believes the Central Plains and Han Chinese betrayed Nanman after Nanman forces fought alongside them in the Great Faction War.
Baeksang attacked Jin in the prison with tangible internal energy, injuring his forehead, while Jin remained still and confronted him.
The Fire Dragon Pavilion was attacked after Jin left, Dark Heaven is suspected of involvement, and Heugung and Yohi remain missing after the destruction of Yohi's Western Yao Estate.
Chief Jang and Chief Go are keeping the three Han Chinese reconnaissance-squad captives away from the Inner Palace.
Song Ilseom and Hyuk Mujin remain bound and unconscious, while Ju Hwaran remains among the captives.
The reconnaissance squad is traveling through Nanman while guarding against the Blood Monk.
open_questions: Whether Baeksang's account of the Western Army's betrayal and the destruction of its evidence is fully accurate remains unresolved.
What did Baeksang mean when he said that Jin's people showed him what he had to do?
Why did the Southern Heaven Demon Empress order or permit Jin's execution to be delayed for two days?
Can Jin survive the scheduled public execution?
What role did Baeksang play in the attacks and the alleged collusion with Dark Heaven?
temporary_decisions: Use Great Snow Fiend for 대설귀.
Use Western Army for 서군 and Southern Army for 남군.
Retain Force-Sealing Pill for 금력단 and iron balls for 철구.
Retain Outer Lands for 새외 and Han Chinese for 한족.
